checkout: hosted payment page, single-stage capture, prepaid manual renewal
deploymentState: Legacy alternative; current selected provider is Halyk ePay. See halyk-epay-setup.json.
activationSteps: Owner registers merchant account and accepts provider contract for ИП AZIRAL.
Store merchant ID and signing secret in /opt/aziralpdf/billing.env (0600), not in chat or Git.
Enable Check URL verification with the merchant manager, and use single-stage card capture (pg_auto_clearing=1).
Complete store approval, configure fiscal receipt issuance with the provider or the merchant's accounting service before live launch; app email is only confirmation.
Enable test mode and verify real sandbox hosted checkout, signed check/result, duplicate notification, and return-page status.
Ask provider to activate Apple Pay on hosted checkout; verify on a supported device before enabling the Apple Pay display flag.
Only after approval and sandbox verification enable live billing; do not use recurring/card-token APIs.
renewal: Manual. No automatic renewal, stored card token or unattended debit.
